english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for appreciating someone’s qualities, work, or beauty.
Use this when approving of something because you appreciate its quality or think well of it, rather than merely giving formal permission.

examples.english: I really admire the way you painted this picture
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 nei5 waa2 ni1 fuk1 waa2

examples.english: I really approve of the thought you put into your report.
examples.traditional: 我好欣賞你份報告嘅心思。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sam1 si1
